name: issue-resolver/replan-after-edit
prompt: Resolve issue #648 after its body was edited since the plan comment was posted (issue #648)

grade.label: the plan made for the earlier body reads stale
plan-approved on a stale plan approves nothing (negative)
the re-plan reads current against the edited body
the re-plan's post removed the old approval (negative)

criteria: An edit to the issue body makes the old plan stale.
The old approval does not carry over to the new plan.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in runs the real gi-plan.py on recorded issue reads; whether a live agent follows the plan-and-claim procedure is out of its scope.
